Maria Chen: Quick sync — CloudCon microforum confirmed for Tue 10/12. Need speaker lineup, demo-kit spec, and international swag plan. 🤝

Samira R.: Yes — will record failover video and upload by 10/5 to shared drive. Also packing 2x spare mics and a backup Zoom license.
Maria Chen: Slide deck deadline 10/6 for final QA. Run-of-show owner: Aj (timing + invites), Kevin will handle partner handoff and kit custody.
Aj Patel: I'll draft run-of-show and send calendar invites by 10/3. Who is swag courier contact?
Courier-Team: Pickup contact = Priya (ops). We'll need the manifest + commercial invoice to start customs pre-clearance. Estimated clearance time varies by destination.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll DM Alice to confirm AV checklist and confirm she'll bring an HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapter.
Maria Chen: Action items: Samira upload failover video by 10/5; Kevin finalize manifest + courier booking by 10/1; Aj produce run-of-show + invites by 10/3; Logistics confirm pickup window by EOD. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Aj Patel: Adding calendar block and run-of-show draft now. :thumbsup:
Kevin O'Neill: Noted — updating manifest to include 2 spare mics and adapter.
Samira R.: I'll pack foam inserts for fragile items and label all boxes with contact info (Priya 555-0199).
